# docker.container runs an image built here from a static Go binary, with
# ports, environment and a healthcheck. A second run does nothing, a stopped
# or removed container is created again, a config change or a new image
# recreates it, a failing healthcheck fails the target, and --clean removes
# the container.
[!docker] skip
[!exec:go] skip
[!exec:curl] skip

# HOME is empty, so the docker CLI finds no user-installed buildx plugin.
exec sh -c 'p=$(command -v docker-buildx) || exit 0; mkdir -p "$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins" && ln -s "$p" "$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx"'

# TEMPORARY: time Go's first use and compile apart from the first bit run.
exec go version
exec go build -o /dev/null .

bit
stdout 'server ✔ ok'
stdout 'image ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ▶ docker run -d --name bit-test-app-[0-9a-f]{12} -p 127\.0\.0\.1::8080 -e GREETING=\*\*\* --restart no .*--health-cmd check --health-interval 1s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 bit-test-app-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
stdout 'app │ healthy'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
bit names
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\Ahello\n\z'
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{.State.Health.Status}} {{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}} {{.Config.Healthcheck.Retries}}" "$name"'
stdout '\Ahealthy no 5\n\z'

bit
stdout 'app · no changes'

# A container stopped or removed out of band is created again.
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker stop -t 0 "$name" >/dev/null'
bit
stdout 'app ▶ .*\(container not running\)'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\Ahello\n\z'

exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null'
bit
stdout 'app ▶ .*\(container not running\)'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\Ahello\n\z'

# Another container that took the name is replaced.
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && image=$(docker inspect --format "{{.Config.Image}}" "$name") && docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null && docker run -d --name "$name" -p 127.0.0.1::8080 "$image" >/dev/null'
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\A\n\z'
bit
stdout 'app ▶ .*\(container replaced\)'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\Ahello\n\z'

# Changed environment recreates the container from the same image.
cp BUILD.bit.hi BUILD.bit
bit
stdout 'image · no changes'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\Ahi\n\z'

# A new binary rebuilds the image, which recreates the container.
cp main.go.loud main.go
bit
stdout 'server ✔ ok'
stdout 'image ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ▶ .*\(image changed\)'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
exec sh get.sh
stdout '\AHI\n\z'

# A healthcheck that fails fails the target and removes its container.
! bit sick
stdout 'sick ✘ container healthcheck failed: unhealthy'
! exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker container inspect "$sick"'

cp names.sh saved.sh
bit --clean
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker container inspect "$name"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "$name:v1"'
# The rebuild kept the previous image's pinned tag while the old container
# used it, and --clean removes that too.
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker images -q --filter "label=id=${name##*-}" | grep .'

-- BUILD.bit --
let id   = replace(sha256(project_dir()), "^(.{12}).*$", "$1")
let arch = replace(replace(trim(exec("docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}'")), "^aarch64$", "arm64"), "^x86_64$", "amd64")

server = go.exe {
  package = "."
  output  = "server"
  cgo     = false
  goos    = "linux"
  goarch  = arch
}

image = docker.image {
  tag        = "bit-test-app-#{id}:v1"
  build_args = { ID = id }
  depends_on = [server]
}

app = docker.container {
  image       = image.ref
  name        = "bit-test-app-#{id}"
  ports       = ["127.0.0.1::8080"]
  environment = { GREETING = "hello" }
  healthcheck = { test = "check", retries = 5 }
}

explicit sick = docker.container {
  image       = image.ref
  name        = "bit-test-sick-#{id}"
  healthcheck = { test = "fail", interval = 100ms, timeout = 1s }
}

explicit names = exec {
  command = "printf 'name=%s\nsick=%s\n' bit-test-app-#{id} bit-test-sick-#{id} > names.sh"
  outputs = "names.sh"
  inputs  = []
}
-- BUILD.bit.hi --
let id   = replace(sha256(project_dir()), "^(.{12}).*$", "$1")
let arch = replace(replace(trim(exec("docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}'")), "^aarch64$", "arm64"), "^x86_64$", "amd64")

server = go.exe {
  package = "."
  output  = "server"
  cgo     = false
  goos    = "linux"
  goarch  = arch
}

image = docker.image {
  tag        = "bit-test-app-#{id}:v1"
  build_args = { ID = id }
  depends_on = [server]
}

app = docker.container {
  image       = image.ref
  name        = "bit-test-app-#{id}"
  ports       = ["127.0.0.1::8080"]
  environment = { GREETING = "hi" }
  healthcheck = { test = "check", retries = 5 }
}

explicit sick = docker.container {
  image       = image.ref
  name        = "bit-test-sick-#{id}"
  healthcheck = { test = "fail", interval = 100ms, timeout = 1s }
}

explicit names = exec {
  command = "printf 'name=%s\nsick=%s\n' bit-test-app-#{id} bit-test-sick-#{id} > names.sh"
  outputs = "names.sh"
  inputs  = []
}
-- get.sh --
# Fetch the page the container that names.sh names serves.
. ./names.sh
curl -fsS --retry 10 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors "http://$(docker port "$name" 8080/tcp | head -n 1)/"
-- Dockerfile --
FROM scratch
# A label unique to the project gives its image an ID no other run shares.
ARG ID
LABEL id=$ID
COPY server /server
# Docker runs a healthcheck with /bin/sh -c, and scratch has no shell.
COPY server /bin/sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
-- go.mod --
module example.com/server

go 1.22
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	// As /bin/sh -c, run a healthcheck: "check" probes the server.
	if filepath.Base(os.Args[0]) == "sh" {
		if len(os.Args) == 3 && os.Args[2] == "check" {
			if _, err := http.Get("http://127.0.0.1:8080/"); err == nil {
				os.Exit(0)
			}
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprintln(w, os.Getenv("GREETING"))
	})
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- main.go.loud --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	// As /bin/sh -c, run a healthcheck: "check" probes the server.
	if filepath.Base(os.Args[0]) == "sh" {
		if len(os.Args) == 3 && os.Args[2] == "check" {
			if _, err := http.Get("http://127.0.0.1:8080/"); err == nil {
				os.Exit(0)
			}
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprintln(w, strings.ToUpper(os.Getenv("GREETING")))
	})
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
